description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ClientTransactionNotFoundException' used within the FinTech project managed by Apache Fineract. The exception is thrown when a client transaction with a specific ID is not found, and it extends a generic domain rule exception class to integrate with the project’s error handling mechanism.

classes.name: ClientTransactionNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a client's transaction with specific ID was not found.

methods.name: ClientTransactionNotFoundException (Long, Long)
methods.description: Constructor called when a transaction is not found for a client, with transaction ID and client ID.

methods.name: ClientTransactionNotFoundException (Long, ExternalId)
methods.description: Constructor called when a transaction is not found for a client, with transaction ID as ExternalId.

methods.name: ClientTransactionNotFoundException (Long, Long, EmptyResultDataAccessException)
methods.description: Constructor called when a transaction is not found and an additional exception is provided.
